profile.headline: Sr. Cybersecurity Embedded Software Engineer at Ecolab
profile.summary:
*Residency Status - United States Citizen.
Senior Firmware Engineer, with a decade of experience, skilled in developing embedded software for automotive, access control, and smart home IoT products. Delivered efficient firmware launches and improved deployment with streamlined CI/CD, Process and AI tool integration. Experienced in optimizing team workflows for reliable results. Focused on driving high-quality embedded systems for connected devices.

positions.title: Sr. Cybersecurity Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Remediating application and cloud security vulnerabilities in embedded Linux products.
● Supporting migration of monolithic Linux systems to containerized architectures.
● Leading Generative AI adoption and best practices for firmware documentation and process.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Azure DevOps Services · Docker · Embedded Security

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Integrated Wi-Fi and MQTT v5.0 IoT connectivity using ESP32-C6 MCUs.
● Executed board bring-up with Zephyr RTOS on 32-bit STM32 ARM microcontrollers.
● Directed AI integration initiatives to streamline engineering workflows. 
● Constructed GitHub CI/CD pipelines to automate firmware releases for secure boot.
● Worked with the team on developing and testing touch screen Display firmware.
● Collaborated cross-functionally across Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet of Things (IoT) · WiFi · ESP32 Microcontrollers · STM32 · Zephyr · CI/CD · LCD Display

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer Consultant and Educator
positions.description:
• Conducting educational seminars on embedded software firmware engineering for high school students in my community for non-profit organizations, fostering interest in technology.
  
• Providing consulting on best practices for firmware development and generative AI initiatives within the embedded community in my existing and growing network.

• Contributing to open-source projects on GitHub, enhancing collaborative learning and innovation.

• Currently enrolled in advanced training courses on various platforms like Coursera, Data Camp, LinkedIn Learning, Embedded Online Conference, Apna College in disciplines:

- AI/ML engineering (topics includes data processing, visualization, model training, building AI agents and Agentic AI using NumPy, Pandas, matplotlib, Kaggle, scikit Learn, pytorch, SQL, Flask, OpenAI APIs, jupyter lab, anaconda).
- Best Practices in Firmware Development,
- Generative AI Prompt Engineering Specialization
- Specialization tracks in Agile Project Management, Product Ownership and People Management

positions.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
positions.locationName: Oak Brook, Illinois, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Developed firmware for wireless remotes, keypads, and wall controls in Linux (WSL), integrating BLE/RF for garage door openers; delivered product releases for all SKUs within schedule.

• Contributed to system architecture and product design, enhanced manufacturing firmware programming workflows, and validated methodologies to ensure robust and efficient production processes.

• Led cross-functional firmware delivery, aligning Systems, Middleware, UI/UX, Hardware, QA, Manufacturing, Regulatory, and Product Management teams; achieved 20% faster sprint completions.

• Improved Scrum processes as Scrum Master by automating JIRA tasks and championing GitHub Copilot usage, resulting in a 15% reduction in workflow bottlenecks.

• Collaborated with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines and enforce code standards with SonarQube; increased deployment frequency by 30%.

• Led offshore firmware teams in India and Mexico, completing all projects within delivery timeline.

• Supported alpha/beta testing for smart home products; implemented user feedback that improved satisfaction ratings by 25% and lower bug reports in the field.

• Completed 2-day onsite training "Building Faster, Smarter Firmware" by Jacob Beningo from Embedded Online Conference, applying techniques to reduce firmware build times by 10%.

• Won best technical design award at internal hackathon, leading to adoption of innovation strategies.

• Mentored interns in technical and cross-functional skills, resulting intern promotion to full-time role.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · C (Programming Language) · Software Architecture · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Agile Project Management · Product Leadership · Firmware

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed firmware in Embedded C/C++ for STM32 with USB and CCID interfaces, expanding card reading functionality to output as keystrokes on the host PC.
• Implemented ECDH asymmetric cryptography (OpenSSL/uECC/mbedTLS), improving device security.
• Modernized GUI configuration tools with AutoIT, increasing efficiency by 25%.
• Ported firmware to new microcontrollers during chip shortages, maintaining 100% delivery timelines.
• Collaborated across teams and stakeholders, lowering post-release issues by 15%.
• Enhanced the software development lifecycle by integrating Waterfall processes and GitHub version control, and completed product security training, resulting in improved compliance with security standards.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed firmware for contactless readers using BLE, NFC, and RF, supporting ISO 14443, 15693, 18092 protocols, Apple Wallet, and Google Pay to enable secure payments and broader device compatibility.
• Integrated ISO-7816 smart-card support into the firmware using HID and NXP SDKs, resulting in reliable and scalable interfaces for secure transactions.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed automotive embedded software in C for key ECU and BCU programs, improving response time by 20% and reliability by 30% while meeting LIN, CAN bus, and AUTOSAR standards.
• Implemented firmware interfaces (Switch Matrix, LED, GPIOs, EEPROM, Motor Control, UART, SPI, I2C), reducing hardware integration issues by 25%.
• Led full SDLC product development, delivering 100% of projects on schedule.
• Contributed to schematic reviews and OEM meetings with GM, Ford, and Honda, reducing design-related change requests by 15%.
• Delivered individual and team firmware tasks with a 95% first-time pass rate in code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Technical Presentations · Software Lifecycle · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Requirement Specifications · Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) · Software Documentation · C (Programming Language) · Debugging · Software Testing

positions.title: RF Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Acquired RF design expertise on LTE and CDMA network projects, including Macro, In-building, DAS, and Small Cell sites by Optimizing network performance, increasing coverage reliability by 15% through RSRP and SNR-based calculations.
• Generated over 40 RF Compliance forms, ensuring 100% FCC regulatory adherence.
• Delivered engineering solutions that reduced sector-trigger incidents and improved sector efficiency by 20%.
positions.insights: Skills: Radio Frequency (RF) · Engineering · Technical Presentations · Engineering Documentation

positions.title: Product Test Engineer (Embedded Systems)
positions.description:
● Worked on products like chart recorders and data loggers using agile methodology.
● Achieved embedded firmware development, debugging and testing skills on 8-bit MCUs.
● Calibration of temperature sensors pt-100, thermocouple, and bipolar/unipolar voltage inputs on Masibus.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Cases · Engineering · Software Documentation · Engineering Documentation · Debugging · Software Testing
